<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY internal 'Expanded Value'>">
  %ent;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?target-pi data="processing-instruction-content"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.org/sub">
  <!-- Comment enclosing entity and CDATA -->
  <sub:child id="1">& internal;&logo;
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing <tags> & references;
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "BaseEntity">
  <!ENTITY derived "&base; Extended">
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="style.xsl"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://schemas.example.org/catalog" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Header comment -->
  <item xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      First CDATA block with entity reference: &derived;
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item>
    <![CDATA[
      Second CDATA block: <xml> content & more
    ]]>
  </item>
</catalog>
```

<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section)*>

  <!ENTITY % paramEntity "<!ELEMENT note (#PCDATA)>">
  %paramEntity;
  <!ENTITY ent "Standard Entity">
]>

  <section xlink:href="http://example.com">

    ]]>
  </section>
</document>

    ]]>

]>

  <!-- Project task schedule comment -->
  <task:task id="t2">
    <![CDATA[
      Task details: &task2; with binary audio attachment reference.
    ]]>
  </task:task>
</project>
